info.name: URL Shortener API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the URL Shortener project.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set the `baseUrl` variable to `http://localhost:8080`
3. Run **Register** → **Login** (token is auto-saved) → use any other endpoint

## Auth
All `/api/urls` endpoints require a Bearer token. The **Login** request automatically saves it to the `token` variable via a test script.

item.name: Auth
item.description: User registration and login endpoints. No authentication required.

request.description:
Creates a new user account.

**Request Body:**
- `username` (string, required) — unique username
- `password` (string, required) — plain text (hashed with BCrypt on server)

**Response:** `201 Created` with user details

Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token.

**Response:** `200 OK`
```json
{ "token": "eyJ..." }
```

⚡ The test script automatically saves the token to `{{token}}` so all other requests work without manual copying.

item.name: URLs
item.description: URL management endpoints. All require `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` header.

request.description:
Creates a new short URL with an auto-generated short code.

**Request Body:**
- `longUrl` (string, required) — the original long URL
- `customAlias` (string, optional) — custom short code e.g. `myresume`
- `expiresAt` (string, optional) — ISO 8601 expiry e.g. `2026-12-31T00:00:00`

**Response:** `201 Created`
```json
{ "shortCode": "abc123" }
```

Creates a short URL with a custom alias and optional expiry date.

**Note:** Returns `409 Conflict` if the alias is already taken.

Returns all URLs created by the authenticated user.

**Response:** `200 OK` — array of URL objects
```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "longUrl": "https://leetcode.com",
    "shortCode": "abc123",
    "clickCount": 42,
    "createdAt": "2026-09-01T10:00:00",
    "expiresAt": null
  }
]
```

Returns click analytics for a specific URL.

**Path Variable:** `1` — replace with the actual URL id

**Response:** `200 OK`
```json
{
  "clicks": 120,
  "createdAt": "2026-09-01T10:00:00",
  "expiresAt": "2027-01-01T00:00:00"
}
```

**Note:** Only the owner can view stats. Returns `403 Forbidden` otherwise.

Deletes a URL by its id. Also evicts it from the Redis cache.

**Path Variable:** `1` — replace with the actual URL id

**Response:** `204 No Content`

**Note:** Only the owner can delete their URL. Returns `403 Forbidden` otherwise.

item.name: Redirect
item.description: Public redirect endpoint. No authentication required.

request.description:
Resolves a short code and redirects to the original URL.

**Path Variable:** `abc123` — replace with a real short code

**Flow:**
1. Check Redis cache → if hit, return immediately
2. If miss, fetch from MySQL → store in Redis → return
3. Increment click count

**Response:** `302 Found` with `Location` header pointing to the long URL

**Errors:**
- `404 Not Found` — short code doesn't exist
- `410 Gone` — URL has expired
